policy: index-only: catalog metadata and links; content is never copied

sources.license_note: The GitHub repository is behind organization SAML enforcement, so the LICENSE file cannot be read programmatically. The Pages site and skills.json are publicly served. Index-only: metadata and links, never content.

items.name: Accessibility Pass
items.description: Check a PowerPoint deck, Word document, HTML page, or Markdown file against Microsoft's Accessibility Checker rules (missing alt text, untitled slides, headerless tables, low contrast, illogical reading order) and fix what it finds.
items.author: Tim Karlsson

items.name: AcroForm Writer
items.description: Fill an existing AcroForm PDF's real form fields from supplied data and flatten the result into a finished, non-editable PDF
items.author: Sandeep Angara

items.name: Agent Evaluation Designer
items.description: Design a rigorous, platform-aware evaluation for an AI agent - define what good looks like, pick the right grading method, build a test set, and turn results into a defensible go/no-go decision.
items.author: James Papadimitriou

items.name: Agent Harness Explorer

items.author: Chris Garty and Andrew Hess

items.name: AI Demo Assistant

items.author: Doak Moore

items.name: AI-First Process Redesign
items.description: Redesign your existing processes with AI-first thinking
items.author: Tim Sparks

items.name: AI Use Case Assessment
items.description: Turn any AI/agentic use case idea (chat, uploaded doc, or attached file) into an evidence-grounded, rubric-scored assessment with a customer-branded HTML report. Guides the user question-by-question through intake, categorisation, strengthening, scoring, and reporting — grounded in the Agentic Use Case Assessment Rubric v2. Runs in Microsoft Scout and Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork.
items.author: Alicja Gilderdale

items.name: Anonymised Case Study Writer
items.description: Turn engagement notes into anonymised, publishable case studies without exposing client-confidential details.
items.author: Simon Owen

items.name: Awaiting Reply
items.description: A weekday-morning Scout automation that finds emails you sent that asked for something and never got an answer, reports how many are waiting, and prepares follow-up drafts in each thread's own language that it never sends.
items.author: Allan De Castro

items.name: B2B Outreach Suite
items.description: A six-playbook toolkit for agentic B2B sales outreach: prospect research briefings, cold emails, LinkedIn/social DMs, follow-up cadences, ad copywriting, and objection handling. Configurable via a company profile template, works for any industry, market, and language.
items.author: Marcel

items.name: Blog Content Auditor
items.description: Audit blog posts or a blog library for clarity, structure, evidence, audience fit, and improvement priority.
items.author: Simon Owen

items.name: Blog Post Structure Pass
items.description: Restructure draft or existing blog posts into a stronger narrative without inventing new claims.
items.author: Simon Owen

items.author: Doug Bellingeri

items.name: Brand Voice Pass
items.description: Rewrite drafts into a configurable house style, preserving meaning while removing generic AI phrasing.
items.author: Simon Owen

items.description: A practical operating system for Copilot Studio that gives agents a consistent way to clarify outcomes, choose the right approach, solve problems, make decisions, plan projects, improve processes, handle incidents, and turn repeatable work into reusable skills. Unlike a standard Copilot experience that relies mainly on the prompt and available context, Business OS adds a structured way of working…

items.name: Campaign Deck Builder
items.description: Turn a short interview into a charming, vibrant 3-slide marketing-campaign deck by filling a bundled PowerPoint template.
items.author: Adi Leibowitz

items.name: Classic Text Adventure
items.description: Play a deterministic, resumable Colossal Cave adventure with exact game output and built-in diagnostics.
items.author: Andreas Adner

items.name: Assistente CLT para RH
items.description: Assistente de legislação trabalhista brasileira (CLT) para equipes de RH e Departamento Pessoal. Responde dúvidas sobre férias, 13º salário, aviso prévio, jornada e tipos de rescisão, e calcula verbas rescisórias com memória de cálculo completa usando as tabelas oficiais vigentes de 2026 (salário mínimo, INSS e IRRF, incluindo a Lei 15.270/2025).
items.author: Michael Ferro Pereira

items.name: Commenting Content
items.description: Comments Word or PowerPoint files with Comments.
items.author: AndrewHessMSFT

items.name: Competitive Battlecard Builder
items.description: Build an interactive comparison app, either a sales battlecard advocating for your product against named competitors, or a neutral, unbiased comparison across two or more peer items with no side taken. items.author: Michael Heath

items.name: Conditional Chat Reminder
items.description: Schedule a Teams reminder that sends only when the expected person has not already posted a relevant update.
items.author: Giorgio Ughini

items.name: Conference Session Abstract Pack
items.description: Create CFP-ready talk titles, abstracts, takeaways, speaker notes, and submission copy from a topic.
items.author: Simon Owen

items.name: Content Quality Auditor
items.description: Score documents, pages, posts, or artefact libraries against a configurable quality rubric and recommend fixes.
items.author: Simon Owen

items.name: Copilot & Agents News Scout
items.description: A Monday-morning Scout automation that scans authoritative Microsoft sources for the past week's Copilot, Copilot Studio, and agent news and posts a concise, linked digest to Teams.
items.author: Elliot Margot

items.name: Copilot Studio Harness Picker
items.description: Choose the right Copilot Studio harness and build shape; in Cowork, use GPT-5.6 with High effort for Detailed mode, Claude Opus 5 as fallback, or Auto for Quick mode.
items.author: Liam O'Grady

items.name: Copilot Studio Knowledge Readiness
items.description: Assess whether an uploaded or exported document set is ready to power a Copilot Studio agent. Produces a corpus-based readiness score, prioritized cleanup backlog, chunking and metadata guidance, and a test-prompt suite, while calling out any evidence gaps that require live system review.
items.author: Jay Padimiti

items.name: Copilot Studio Test Planner
items.description: Reads an exported Copilot Studio agent and generates a graded, runnable test suite (happy-path, paraphrase, disambiguation, negative, knowledge-grounding, multilingual, and safety cases) plus a regression set, ready to run in the free Copilot Studio test panel.
items.author: Elliot Margot

items.name: Copilot Studio Topic Blueprint
items.description: Turn a one-line use case into a build-ready Microsoft Copilot Studio agent blueprint: recommended agent type and orchestration, topics, tools, knowledge, variables, a welcome Adaptive Card, security and Copilot Credits notes, and a first test plan.
items.author: Elliot Margot

items.name: Universal Document Converter
items.description: Convert documents between Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel/CSV and text — fully offline, using only the libraries already in the agent sandbox.
items.author: Andreas Adner

items.name: Enterprise Agent Design Authority (EADA)
items.description: An enterprise design review framework that helps architects build secure, scalable, governable, and production-ready Microsoft Copilot Studio agents.
items.author: Faride Ilanda

items.description: Detect greenwashing in product descriptions, marketing copy, and catalog entries against EU Directive 2024/825 and the Green Claims Directive. Returns a structured per-claim findings report with risk levels, regulation references, and recommended corrections.
items.author: Remi Dyon

items.name: Exam Prep Learning Plan Builder
items.description: Build a personalized study plan app for an exam or certification: overview timeline, day-by-day schedule with a calendar picker, domain breakdown, one-click .ics download, and a notes tab to track confidence over time.
items.author: Michael Heath

items.name: Gantt Chart Builder
items.description: Generate clean, consistently-styled matplotlib Gantt charts from a schedule CSV or DataFrame — with group colours, completion overlays, and a today line.
items.author: Nazish Qasim

items.name: Podcast Script Generator
items.description: Turn a topic or a pile of source material — a newsletter, news digest, or set of articles — into a two-host, NotebookLM-style podcast episode, with multi-voice SSML and optional Azure Text-to-Speech audio.
items.author: Remi Dyon

items.name: Global Greenwashing Claim Auditor

items.author: Chris Garty

items.name: Grab My Files
items.description: One-tap way to bundle every file your Copilot Studio agent produced in a session into a single timestamped .zip and hand it back as a download.
items.author: Rafael Alcaraz

items.name: Idea Refiner
items.description: Refines an existing plan, decision, or draft through relentless, branch-by-branch questioning. Grouped in batches of 2-5 with recommended answers, pulling facts from Work IQ where possible, until every part has been fully thought through.
items.author: Mathias Salomonsen

items.name: Institutional Knowledge Archivist
items.description: Preserve a departing senior leader's institutional knowledge — decisions, rationale, relationships, and tribal knowledge — by mining their M365 signals into a structured, multi-phase archive a successor can ground on.
items.author: Srinivas Varukala

items.name: Iterative File Editing
items.description: In Copilot Studio, re-sending an edited file under the same name fails to deliver it — the change is made but never reaches the user. This skill gives each iteration a new version-numbered filename (report_v1.docx, report_v2.docx…) so every update actually lands in the chat as its own attachment.
items.author: Adi Leibowitz

items.name: Knowledge Corpus Curator
items.description: Review uploaded knowledge-source files for duplication, redundancy, staleness, overlap, and potentially conflicting guidance, then produce an evidence-based curation backlog.
items.author: Doug Bellingeri

items.name: Knowledge Source Router
items.description: Route Copilot Studio knowledge searches to the right region-specific source (Americas, EMEA, APAC, or Global) based on where the user is, so answers stay locally accurate.
items.author: Adi Leibowitz

items.name: Lab Column Mapper
items.description: When a health system's lab results ingestion pipeline hits an unknown column header, this skill semantically matches the source column against the canonical clinical schema (LOINC-anchored), scoped by lab and clinical domain, and writes a suggested mapping to a Dataverse review queue for a clinical informatics steward to approve.
items.author: Rafsan Huseynov

items.name: LinkedIn Content System
items.description: Create evidence-led LinkedIn posts, promos, newsletter intros, and long-form copy from supplied facts or drafts.
items.author: Simon Owen

items.name: LinkedIn Content Writer
items.description: Create credible LinkedIn content from facts, notes or drafts, with configurable voice and no invented evidence.
items.author: Becky Still, Digital Boop Ltd

items.name: Dataverse Table Lookup
items.description: Search any Microsoft Dataverse table, browse matching records, and drill into full record details — sourced live via the Dataverse MCP Server.
items.author: Chris Garty

items.name: MCT Excellence IQ
items.description: An AI-powered Instructional Intelligence Skill that helps Microsoft Certified Trainers design, deliver, assess, localize, and continuously improve world-class Microsoft learning experiences across Azure, Business Applications, Data & AI, Modern Work, and Security.
items.author: Faride Ilanda

items.name: Meeting Analyzer
items.description: Analyzes meeting content pasted as text or provided as audio/video transcripts. Delivers a structured intelligence report: explicit decisions and action items, participant persona profiles, and — most importantly — hidden insights: unspoken tensions, implicit risks, unresolved topics, and signals that were not made explicit during the meeting but are critical to the context.
items.author: Michael Ferro Pereira

items.name: Microsoft AI Platform Advisor
items.description: Guides a customer through a discovery interview, recommends the right Microsoft AI platform (M365 Copilot, Agent Builder, Copilot Studio, Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Windows AI Foundry, or Agent 365 as the governance layer), scores technical complexity and risk, and plots them on a 2x2 quadrant chart with planning guidance.
items.author: Rafsan Huseynov

items.name: Monte Carlo Analysis
items.description: Run Monte Carlo simulations from natural-language risk inputs — triangular, normal, uniform, or log-normal — and return percentiles, a histogram PNG, optional interactive HTML, and a downloadable results spreadsheet.

items.name: Own Voice Builder
items.description: Mines your sent emails to extract your real writing voice — languages, tone modes, structure, vocabulary, taboo phrases — and generates a personal voice skill that makes every email and Teams draft sound like you.
items.author: Marcel

items.name: Pattern Radar
items.description: Scans your recent Microsoft 365 signals to surface recurring patterns worth productizing — things you keep explaining (blog candidates) or multi-step tasks you keep doing by hand (automation candidates).
items.author: Srinivas Varukala

items.name: Pattern Radar (Scheduled)
items.description: Twice a week, scans your recent Microsoft 365 signals and posts a Teams summary of recurring patterns worth productizing — things you keep explaining (blog candidates) and multi-step tasks you keep doing by hand (automation candidates). Read-only and privacy-aware.
items.author: Srinivas Varukala

items.name: PDF Table Data Conversion
items.description: Extract tables from a PDF document (e.g. contract rebate or pricing schedules) and convert them into a clean, workable Excel spreadsheet or CSV.
items.author: Lewis Baybutt

items.name: Persona Reaction Panel
items.description: Pre-test an internal launch, comms, or enablement artefact against your own role-based personas before it ships — surfaces blackspots, domain gaps, credible-detractor risks, and concrete edits. Bring your own personas file.
items.author: Olivia Zhang

items.name: PHI De-identifier
items.description: Redact the 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor identifiers from clinical text (or produce a Limited Data Set) with consistent pseudonym tokens and an audit manifest of what was removed.

Maps which flows call each other and unresolved connections automatically.
items.author: Mathias Salomonsen

items.name: Power BI Model Review
items.description: Review a Power BI or Analysis Services semantic model (TMDL, BIM/JSON, or a pasted table/measure list) for relationship, DAX, date-handling, and naming issues, with corrected DAX for anything flagged.
items.author: Tim Karlsson

items.name: PowerPoint Deck Designer
items.description: Creates polished PowerPoint decks from a JSON specification using python-pptx. Designed as a Copilot Studio Skill that runs natively inside the agent's Python container (no Azure Function or custom connector required). Supports 8 layouts plus native charts (bar, column, line, pie, donut with stacked / 100% stacked variants).
items.author: Ferran Chopo

items.name: Presentation Talk Track Builder
items.description: Writes natural, first-person spoken presenter scripts for the slides in a deck. Treats existing speaker notes as authoritative when they contradict slide text. Calibrates length to a target duration and speaking pace and returns a timing table. Never modifies visible slide content.

Classifies each item, flags items relevant to the user's team using a light WorkIQ-derived profile, and renders a self-contained HTML dashboard. A tightly-bounded fallback web search is used only when a locked source is silent in the wind…
items.author: Jagmeet Chabra

items.name: Rich HTML Presentation
items.description: Create polished, self-contained HTML slide decks with keynote-style visuals, keyboard navigation, themes, animations, and reusable presentation components.

items.description: Turns data into a scroll-driven HTML story.

items.name: SharePoint List Insight Report Generator

The report includes dynamic filters, interactive charts, sortable and searchable tables with pagination, detailed record drill-down through modal popups, and direct links to open items…
